item.title: Middle East Eye: Flights between Iran and Iraq's Najaf to resume on Sunday, Iraqi state news agency says
item.description: Flights between Iran and Iraq's Najaf to resume on Sunday, Iraqi state news agency says Iraq's Najaf International Airport will resume flights to and from Iran from Sunday, with three evening flights scheduled, Iraq's state news agency cited the airport as saying on Saturday. Iraq said on Friday a US waiver would allow Iranian airlines to operate up to 40 daily flights to and from Najaf, excluding Mahan Air.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Report: Israeli attempt to kill senior Hamas official fails
item.description: Report: Israeli attempt to kill senior Hamas official fails Israeli army radio said an attempt to assassinate Ali al-Amoudi, the deputy head of Hamas’s political bureau in Gaza, had failed. Israeli reports have described al-Amoudi as effectively taking over the running of the enclave from Yahya Sinwar.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Israeli attack injures several Palestinians in Gaza
item.description: Israeli attack injures several Palestinians in Gaza An Israeli drone attack injured several Palestinians in Gaza City on Friday evening, Wafa news agency reported, citing medical sources. The report said that a number of injured people, some of them seriously wounded, arrived at the hospital following the strike, which targeted a group of people near the Abd al-Rahman School, close to the al-Saroukh intersection north of Gaza City.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Palestinian man succumbs to wounds sustained from Israeli attack in Deir el-Balah
item.description: Palestinian man succumbs to wounds sustained from Israeli attack in Deir el-Balah A Palestinian man has succumbed to a gunshot wound sustained in an attack by Israeli forces in central Gaza's Deir el-Balah, Wafa reports, citing medical sources. According to the sources, Mohammad Talat Aqel, from Jabalia refugee camp died after sustaining a gunshot wound to the head several days ago in the Umm Dhuhair area of Deir al-Balah. He was reportedly receiving treatment at the city's Al-Aqsa Hospital.

item.description: Fire, smoke seen near Aramco facility in Riyadh, witness says A large plume of smoke and fire was seen rising in the vicinity of an Aramco facility in Riyadh on Saturday, a witness told Reuters.
